lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Let me give you the full picture first. Our warehouse runs two shifts. The day shift handles inbound trucks and the night shift does all the picking for next-day orders. Most of our errors happen on the night shift, because that team is half temps and the scanners there are older. Last quarter we had a spike in wrong items shipped, and almost all of it traced back to nights. Management wants a fix before the holiday peak. Given all that, where would you focus first?
